the combination of microfluidics and microfluidics-based soft robotics has the potential to enable the miniaturization of wearable assistive systems.

(1) the synergistic combination of microfluidics and micro-soft robotics could enable new applications and (2) microfluidics can provide new solutions to the challenges of soft robotics, such as the development of new materials, fabrication techniques, actuation mechanisms, and control strategies.
microfluidics can be synergized with soft robotics to achieve the miniaturization of soft robotics, thus paving the way to more practical applications.

how to use the principles of microfluidics for miniaturizing and improving the performance of soft robots.
the synergistic application of microfluidics and microfabrication to soft robotics for miniaturization and the design of soft actuators and sensors for wearable systems.
developing microfluidic technologies for the miniaturization of soft robotic systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
microfluidics and microfluidic devices have the potential to be applied to soft robotics to enable miniaturization and thus improve the user experience of soft robotic systems.

the combination of soft robotics and microfluidics could enable the realization of a new generation of wearable systems, which are more human friendly, more efficient, and more precise than existing ones, with a potential impact on many aspects of human daily life.
microfluidics has the potential to be a key enabling technology for soft robotics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
soft robotics and microfluidics have a strong synergy in terms of the soft materials and the fluidic actuation.
microfluidics can help soft robots to miniaturize, and soft robotics can help microfluidics to realize more functions.

the combination of microfluidics and microfluidic-based technologies with soft robotics could be a powerful tool to address miniaturization challenges in soft robotics and enable the development of truly impactful soft wearable systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synergistic integration of microfluidics and robotics could be a powerful approach to address many challenges in soft robotics and could be a promising research topic to explore.

the synergy between soft robotics and microfluidics can be achieved by using microfluidics as a platform technology for the development of soft robotic devices and by using soft robotics as a platform technology in the field of microfluidics.

microfluidics has the potential to provide soft robotics with a toolbox of new materials, new manufacturing methods, and new ways for control and sensing that are miniaturized, efficient, and precise.
